title: Automated Versus Conventional Hospital Discharge Summaries and Prescriptions
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether a semi-automated electronic patient discharge summary program leads to increased community physician and housestaff satisfaction and patient outcomes as compared to conventional discharge reports.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hospitalization on General Internal Medicine ward at St. Michael's Hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* Transfer to another service
* Death during admission
* Remains in hospital past dates specified in study protocol
